entries.name: Śrī Krishna
entries.about: The Supreme Personality of Godhead, the cowherd boy of Vraja and the source of all incarnations.

variants.name: Govinda
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the one who gives pleasure to the cows, the land and the senses.

variants.name: Gopīnāth
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the Lord and beloved of the gopīs.

variants.name: Mādhava
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the sweet Lord of springtime, born in the Madhu dynasty, the husband of Mā, the goddess of fortune.

variants.name: Keśava
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the one with beautiful hair, who killed the demon Keśī.

variants.name: Śyāmasundar
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the beautiful one, dark like a rain cloud.

variants.name: Śyāma
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the dark one, whose complexion is like a fresh rain cloud.

variants.name: Giridhārī
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the lifter of Govardhan Hill.

variants.name: Gopāl
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the cowherd boy, protector of the cows.

variants.name: Dāmodar
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the one whose waist (udara) Mother Yaśodā bound with a rope (dāma).

variants.name: Mukunda
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the giver of liberation, and of the love that makes liberation insignificant.

variants.name: Hṛṣīkeśa
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the master of everyone’s senses.

variants.name: Kānāi
variants.about: Krishna’s affectionate Bengali name, used by His family and friends in Vraja.

variants.name: Hari
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the one who takes away all that is inauspicious and steals the hearts of His devotees.

variants.name: Murāri
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the enemy of the demon Mura.

variants.name: Krishnachandra
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the moon of Vraja.

variants.name: Yādava
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the descendant of King Yadu, the jewel of the Yadu dynasty.

variants.name: Madhusūdan
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the killer of the demon Madhu.

variants.name: Janārdana
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the one to whom all people pray, the protector of His devotees.

variants.name: Achyuta
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the infallible one, who never falls from His position.

variants.name: Madana-mohan
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the one who enchants even Cupid (Madana); also the Deity served by Sanātan Goswāmī in Vṛndāvan.

variants.name: Nanda-nandana
variants.about: A name of Krishna: the son of Nanda Mahārāja, the king of Vraja.

entries.name: Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī
entries.about: Krishna’s eternal consort and the embodiment of His pleasure potency, worshipped as the queen of Vṛndāvan.

variants.name: Rādhikā
variants.about: A name of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī: the one who worships Krishna best.

variants.name: Vṛṣabhānunandinī
variants.about: A name of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī: the daughter of King Vṛṣabhānu.

variants.name: Gāndharvā
variants.about: A name of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī: the best of singers and dancers.

entries.name: Śrī Chaitanya Mahāprabhu
entries.about: Krishna Himself, appearing in Nabadwīp in 1486 with Rādhā’s heart and golden lustre to give the world love for Krishna through the chanting of the Holy Name.

variants.name: Gaurāṅga
variants.about: A name of Śrī Chaitanya Mahāprabhu: the one whose limbs are golden.

variants.name: Gaurasundar
variants.about: A name of Śrī Chaitanya Mahāprabhu: the beautiful golden Lord.

variants.name: Gaurahari
variants.about: A name of Śrī Chaitanya Mahāprabhu: Hari, Krishna Himself, in golden form.

variants.name: Gaurachandra
variants.about: A name of Śrī Chaitanya Mahāprabhu: the golden moon.

variants.name: Nimāi
variants.about: Mahāprabhu’s childhood name: He was born under a neem tree.

variants.name: Viśvambhara
variants.about: Mahāprabhu’s given name: the one who sustains the universe.

entries.name: Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu
entries.about: Balarām appearing as Mahāprabhu’s first expansion and closest companion, the most merciful giver of the Holy Name.

variants.name: Nitāi
variants.about: The affectionate name of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu.

entries.name: Śrī Advaita Āchārya
entries.about: Mahā-Viṣṇu’s incarnation, whose prayers brought Mahāprabhu into the world; one of the Pañcha-tattva.

entries.name: Śrī Gadādhara Paṇḍit
entries.about: Mahāprabhu’s intimate associate, the incarnation of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī’s energy; one of the Pañcha-tattva.

entries.name: Śrīvās Ṭhākur
entries.about: Nārada Muni in Mahāprabhu’s pastimes; nightly kīrtan was held in his courtyard in Māyāpur.

entries.name: Lord Balarām
entries.about: Krishna’s elder brother and first expansion, the original spiritual master.

variants.name: Baladeva
variants.about: A name of Lord Balarām: the Lord of strength.

variants.name: Balabhadra
variants.about: A name of Lord Balarām: the strong and auspicious one.

entries.name: Lord Nārāyaṇa
entries.about: Krishna’s majestic four-armed form, the Lord of Vaikuṇṭha.

entries.name: Lord Viṣṇu
entries.about: The all-pervading Lord who maintains the universe; Krishna’s expansion.

entries.name: Lord Nṛsiṁha
entries.about: The half-man, half-lion incarnation who protected Prahlād and killed Hiraṇyakaśipu.

entries.name: Lord Rāmachandra
entries.about: Krishna’s incarnation as the ideal king of Ayodhyā, who defeated Rāvaṇa.

variants.name: Rāma
variants.about: A name meaning “the one who gives delight”. In the Holy Name the Gauḍīyas see Krishna Himself, who delights Śrī Rādhā; it is also a name of Balarām and of Lord Rāmachandra.

entries.name: Lord Jagannāth
entries.about: Krishna as the Lord of the Universe, worshipped in Purī with Baladeva and Subhadrā.

entries.name: Lord Saṅkarṣaṇa
entries.about: Balarām’s expansion who supports all existence, the source of the Viṣṇu forms.

entries.name: Ananta Śeṣa
entries.about: The thousand-headed serpent expansion of Balarām who serves as Viṣṇu’s bed and eternally sings His glories.

entries.name: Lord Kalki
entries.about: The incarnation who appears at the end of Kali-yuga.

entries.name: Mother Yaśodā
entries.about: Krishna’s foster-mother in Vraja, the queen of Nanda Mahārāja.

entries.name: Nanda Mahārāja
entries.about: Krishna’s foster-father, the king of the cowherds of Vraja.

entries.name: Vṛṣabhānu Mahārāja
entries.about: Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī’s father, a cowherd king of Varṣāṇā.

entries.name: Lalitā Sakhī
entries.about: The foremost of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī’s eight principal friends.

entries.name: Viśākhā Sakhī
entries.about: Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī’s dearest friend, born on the same day as She.

entries.name: Śrī Rūpa Mañjarī
entries.about: The leader of Rādhārāṇī’s young maidservants; Śrī Rūpa Goswāmī’s eternal form.

entries.name: Madhumaṅgal
entries.about: Krishna’s jolly brāhmaṇ friend in Vraja.

entries.name: Lord Brahmā
entries.about: The first created being, engineer of the universe and head of the Brahma-Mādhva line.

entries.name: Lord Śiva
entries.about: The greatest Vaiṣṇava among the demigods, who presides over the mode of ignorance.

entries.name: Indra
entries.about: The king of heaven, humbled when Krishna lifted Govardhan Hill.

entries.name: Lakṣmī Devī
entries.about: The goddess of fortune, eternal consort of Nārāyaṇa.

variants.name: Nārāyaṇī
variants.about: A name of Lakṣmī Devī: the consort of Nārāyaṇa.

entries.name: Tulasī Devī
entries.about: Krishna’s beloved plant-devotee, Vṛndā Devī, without whose leaves He accepts no offering.

entries.name: Śachī Devī
entries.about: Mahāprabhu’s mother, Yaśodā in Gaura-līlā.

entries.name: Jagannāth Miśra
entries.about: Mahāprabhu’s father, Nanda Mahārāja in Gaura-līlā.

entries.name: Sītā Ṭhākurāṇī
entries.about: Śrī Advaita Āchārya’s wife and a great devotee.

entries.name: Viṣṇu Priyā Devī
entries.about: Mahāprabhu’s second wife, who served the Holy Name in separation from Him.

entries.name: Lakṣmī Priyā
entries.about: Mahāprabhu’s first wife.

entries.name: Śrīla Haridās Ṭhākur
entries.about: Mahāprabhu’s associate who chanted three hundred thousand names daily, honoured as the nāmāchārya.

entries.name: Śrī Svarūp Dāmodar
entries.about: Mahāprabhu’s secretary and closest confidant in Purī, Lalitā in Krishna-līlā.

entries.name: Śrī Rāmānanda Rāy
entries.about: Governor and poet with whom Mahāprabhu discussed the highest truths of devotion on the Godāvarī.

entries.name: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭāchārya
entries.about: The great logician of Purī whom Mahāprabhu converted to devotion.

entries.name: Murāri Gupta
entries.about: Mahāprabhu’s physician-associate and early biographer, a devotee of Lord Rāma.

entries.name: Mukunda Datta
entries.about: A sweet singer and childhood friend of Mahāprabhu.

entries.name: Śrī Mādhavendra Purī
entries.about: The seed of the tree of divine love and grand-guru of Mahāprabhu.

entries.name: Śrī Īśvara Purī
entries.about: Mahāprabhu’s initiating guru, a disciple of Mādhavendra Purī.

entries.name: King Pratāparudra
entries.about: The king of Orissa who served Mahāprabhu and Lord Jagannāth.

entries.name: Prakāśānanda Saraswatī
entries.about: The leading Māyāvādī sannyāsī of Kāśī, converted by Mahāprabhu.

entries.name: Jagāi and Mādhāi
entries.about: Two notorious brothers of Nabadwīp delivered by Nityānanda Prabhu.

entries.name: Keśava Kāśmīrī
entries.about: A champion scholar defeated by young Nimāi Paṇḍit; later a Vaiṣṇava āchārya.

entries.name: Balabhadra Bhaṭṭāchārya
entries.about: Mahāprabhu’s companion and servant on His journey through Jhāḍakhaṇḍa to Vṛndāvan.

entries.name: Śrīla Rūpa Goswāmī
entries.about: The leader of the six Goswāmīs, empowered by Mahāprabhu to establish the science of rasa.

entries.name: Śrīla Sanātan Goswāmī
entries.about: Rūpa Goswāmī’s elder brother, taught by Mahāprabhu in Kāśī; the teacher of sambandha.

entries.name: Śrīla Jīva Goswāmī
entries.about: Rūpa and Sanātan’s nephew, the great philosopher of the school and author of the Sandarbhas.

entries.name: Śrīla Raghunāth Dās Goswāmī
entries.about: The renunciate prince who lived at Rādhā Kuṇḍa, the prayojanāchārya.

entries.name: Śrīla Raghunāth Bhaṭṭa Goswāmī
entries.about: The Goswāmī famed for his sweet recitation of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.

entries.name: Śrīla Gopāl Bhaṭṭa Goswāmī
entries.about: The Goswāmī from South India who served Śrī Rādhā-Ramaṇ.

entries.name: The Six Goswāmīs
entries.about: Rūpa, Sanātan, Jīva, Raghunāth Dās, Raghunāth Bhaṭṭa and Gopāl Bhaṭṭa, who established Mahāprabhu’s teachings in Vṛndāvan.

entries.name: Śrīla Krishnadās Kavirāj Goswāmī
entries.about: Author of Śrī Chaitanya-charitāmṛta, the definitive account of Mahāprabhu’s life and teachings.

entries.name: Śrī Lokanāth Goswāmī
entries.about: Mahāprabhu’s associate in Vṛndāvan and Narottam Dās Ṭhākur’s guru.

entries.name: Śrīla Narottam Dās Ṭhākur
entries.about: The prince-poet whose Bengali songs are the heart of Gauḍīya kīrtan.

entries.name: Śrīla Śrīnivās Āchārya
entries.about: The great preacher who, with Narottam Dās Ṭhākur and Śyāmānanda Prabhu, brought the Goswāmīs’ books from Vṛndāvan to Bengal and spread Mahāprabhu’s teachings there.

entries.name: Śrī Rāmachandra Kavirāj
entries.about: Śrīnivās Āchārya’s disciple and Narottam Dās Ṭhākur’s inseparable friend, whose company Narottam prays for in his songs.

entries.name: Śrīla Lochan Dās Ṭhākur
entries.about: Poet of Śrī Chaitanya-maṅgala and many songs of Gaura-līlā.

entries.name: Śrīla Vyāsadeva
entries.about: The compiler of the Vedas and author of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.

entries.name: Śrī Nārada Muni
entries.about: The travelling sage who spreads devotion throughout the universe; Vyāsadeva’s guru.

entries.name: Śukadeva Goswāmī
entries.about: Vyāsadeva’s son, who spoke Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam to King Parīkṣit.

entries.name: Śrī Madhvāchārya
entries.about: The 13th-century founder of the Tattvavāda school, in whose line Mahāprabhu took initiation.

entries.name: Śaṅkarāchārya
entries.about: The 8th-century teacher of impersonal monism, an incarnation of Śiva.

entries.name: Śrīla Bhakti Vinod Ṭhākur
entries.about: The pioneer of pure devotion in the modern age, poet of many songs in this book.

entries.name: Śrīla Jagannāth Dās Bābājī Mahārāja
entries.about: The head of the Vaiṣṇavas of his time, who identified Mahāprabhu’s birthplace.

entries.name: Śrīla Gaura Kiśora Dās Bābājī Mahārāja
entries.about: The renunciate paramahaṁsa and guru of Śrīla Saraswatī Ṭhākur.
aliases: Śrīla Gaura Kiśora Dās Bābājī Mahārāja

entries.name: Śrīla Bhakti Siddhānta Saraswatī Ṭhākur
entries.about: The founder of the Gauḍīya Maṭh, who carried Mahāprabhu’s message across India and to the West.

variants.name: Prabhupād
variants.about: The title by which the Sāraswat line honours Śrīla Bhakti Siddhānta Saraswatī Ṭhākur: the one at whose feet the masters sit.

variants.name: Śrī Vārṣabhānavī Dayita Dās
variants.about: Śrīla Bhakti Siddhānta Saraswatī Ṭhākur’s name before sannyāsa: the servant of the beloved of Śrī Rādhā.

entries.name: Śrīla Bhakti Rakṣak Śrīdhar Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāja
entries.about: The founder-āchārya of Śrī Chaitanya Sāraswat Maṭh, guardian of devotion.
aliases: Oṁ Viṣṇupād Śrī Śrīla Bhakti Rakṣak Śrīdhar Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāja
Śrīla Bhakti Rakṣak Śrīdhar Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāja

entries.name: Śrīla Bhakti Sundar Govinda Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāja
entries.about: Śrīla Śrīdhar Mahārāja’s successor, who spread the Maṭh’s mission around the world.
aliases: Śrīla Bhakti Sundar Govinda Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāja

entries.name: Śrīla A.C. Bhaktivedānta Swāmī Prabhupāda
entries.about: Founder-āchārya of ISKCON, who spread the Holy Name worldwide.

entries.name: Śrīla Bhakti Bimal Avadhūt Mahārāja
entries.about: Disciple of Śrīla Govinda Mahārāja and head of the Russian mission of Śrī Chaitanya Sāraswat Maṭh.

entries.name: Śrīla Bhakti Sudhīr Goswāmī Mahārāja
entries.about: A senior sannyāsī of Śrī Chaitanya Sāraswat Maṭh, founder of the Guardian of Devotion Press.

entries.name: Śrīla Bhakti Rañjan Madhusūdan Mahārāja
entries.about: A sannyāsī of Śrī Chaitanya Sāraswat Maṭh.

entries.name: Śrīla Bhakti Nirmal Āchārya Mahārāja
entries.about: The present āchārya of Śrī Chaitanya Sāraswat Maṭh.

entries.name: Śrīla Baladeva Vidyābhūṣaṇa
entries.about: The 18th-century Gauḍīya āchārya who wrote the Govinda-bhāṣya commentary on Vedānta-sūtra.

entries.name: Prahlād Mahārāja
entries.about: The boy-devotee protected by Lord Nṛsiṁha.

entries.name: Hiraṇyakaśipu
entries.about: The demon king killed by Lord Nṛsiṁha.

entries.name: King Kaṁsa
entries.about: Krishna’s tyrant uncle, the king of Mathurā, killed by Krishna.

entries.name: Rāvaṇa
entries.about: The demon king of Laṅkā killed by Lord Rāmachandra.

entries.name: Pūtanā
entries.about: The witch who tried to poison baby Krishna and was given a mother’s position.

entries.name: Kālīya
entries.about: The many-headed serpent Krishna subdued in the Yamunā.

entries.name: Śrī Vṛndāvan
entries.about: Krishna’s forest home on the Yamunā in Vraja, where the Goswāmīs lived; eternally one with Goloka.

entries.name: Vraja Maṇḍal
entries.about: The land of Krishna’s childhood around Vṛndāvan and Mathurā.

entries.name: Govardhan Hill
entries.about: The hill Krishna lifted for seven days; worshipped as Girirāj, non-different from Him.

variants.name: Girirāj
variants.about: Govardhan Hill as the king of mountains, worshipped as non-different from Krishna.

entries.name: Śrī Rādhā Kuṇḍa
entries.about: Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī’s lake near Govardhan, the most exalted place of worship.

entries.name: Śrī Govinda Kuṇḍa
entries.about: The pond at Govardhan formed by Indra’s bathing of Krishna.
entries.maps: Govind Kund, Aanyor, Uttar Pradesh, India

entries.name: Vaṁśīvaṭa
entries.about: The banyan tree in Vṛndāvan where Krishna’s flute called the gopīs to the rāsa dance.

entries.name: Mathurā
entries.about: Krishna’s birthplace on the Yamunā.

entries.name: Gokul
entries.about: The village of Nanda Mahārāja across the Yamunā, where Krishna spent His infancy.

entries.name: The Yamunā
entries.about: The sacred river of Vraja, Krishna’s beloved.

variants.name: Kālindī
variants.about: A name of the Yamunā: the daughter of the sun-god, who flows from Mount Kalinda.

entries.name: The Ganges
entries.about: The holy river that flows from Lord Viṣṇu’s feet and through Nabadwīp.

entries.name: Śrī Nabadwīp Dhām
entries.about: Mahāprabhu’s birthplace in Bengal, nine islands on the Ganges non-different from Vṛndāvan.

variants.name: Nadia
variants.about: The traditional name of the Nabadwīp district in Bengal, Mahāprabhu’s birthplace.

entries.name: Śrī Māyāpur
entries.about: The island of Nabadwīp where Mahāprabhu appeared.

entries.name: Godruma
entries.about: The island of Nabadwīp where Śrīla Bhakti Vinod Ṭhākur lived at Svānanda-sukhada-kuñja.
entries.maps: Svananda Sukhada Kunja, Godrumadwip, Nabadwip, West Bengal

entries.name: Koladwīp
entries.about: The island of Nabadwīp where Śrī Chaitanya Sāraswat Maṭh stands, non-different from Govardhan.
entries.maps: Sri Chaitanya Saraswat Math, Nabadwip, West Bengal

entries.name: Kuliyā
entries.about: Present Nabadwīp town, where offences are forgiven.

entries.name: Śrī Chaitanya Sāraswat Maṭh
entries.about: The temple founded by Śrīla Śrīdhar Mahārāja in 1941 at Koladwīp, Nabadwīp.
entries.maps: Sri Chaitanya Saraswat Math, Nabadwip, West Bengal

entries.name: Śāntipur
entries.about: Advaita Āchārya’s home on the Ganges.

entries.name: Jagannāth Purī
entries.about: The seaside abode of Lord Jagannāth in Orissa, where Mahāprabhu spent His last years.

variants.name: Nīlāchala
variants.about: A name of Jagannāth Purī: the blue mountain, where Lord Jagannāth’s temple stands.

entries.name: Prayāga
entries.about: The confluence of the Ganges and Yamunā, where Mahāprabhu taught Śrī Rūpa.

entries.name: Kāśī
entries.about: Vārāṇasī, the ancient city of Śiva, where Mahāprabhu taught Sanātan and converted Prakāśānanda.

entries.name: Gayā
entries.about: The holy town where Mahāprabhu met Īśvara Purī and took initiation.

entries.name: Dvārakā
entries.about: Krishna’s royal city on the western sea.

entries.name: The Godāvarī
entries.about: The river where Mahāprabhu met Rāmānanda Rāy.

entries.name: Jhāḍakhaṇḍa
entries.about: The forest Mahāprabhu crossed on His way to Vṛndāvan, making the animals chant.

entries.name: Rāmakeli
entries.about: The village in Bengal where Mahāprabhu first met Rūpa and Sanātan.

entries.name: Śrī Śyāma Kuṇḍa
entries.about: Krishna’s lake beside Rādhā Kuṇḍa near Govardhan.
entries.maps: Shyam Kund, Radha Kund, Uttar Pradesh

entries.name: Goloka Vṛndāvan
entries.about: Krishna’s supreme abode in the spiritual sky.

entries.name: Vaikuṇṭha
entries.about: The spiritual realm of Lord Nārāyaṇa, free from all anxiety.
